phrase: One AI lab sealed its smartest models away from the internet, citing hacking risks. Another company updated its policy so your inbox could feed its AI ads.
phraseAlternatives: A top AI lab cut its newest models off the internet to stay safe. A tech company said your email could soon feed its AI ads.
An AI lab shut its models away from online risk. Another firm said your inbox may soon feed AI-targeted ads.
The smartest AI models just lost their internet access, for safety. Your inbox may soon gain an AI reader, for ads.
One company is protecting its AI from the open internet. Another wants your open inbox to train its ads, if you opt in.
alt: A robot sits sealed inside a glass vault, its cord unplugged from a cloud above, labeled SEALED. Beside it, a person stands next to an open envelope inbox while a small robot peeks over their shoulder holding a megaphone, next to a toggle switch marked OFF.

brief.concept: A lab seals its most advanced AI model inside a glass vault, unplugging it from the open internet, while across the scene a person's inbox envelope grows a small AI robot peeking out, holding an ad-shaped megaphone, with a dotted line to an opt-in switch nearby.
brief.metaphor: Locking away a thing you fear while quietly adding a door to a thing you were supposed to protect.

brief.composition: Two panels split by a thin vertical line. Left: a robot sealed inside a glass vault, a loose cord dangling from a cloud shape above it to show a severed connection.
